description_en: Describes the syntax and provides examples of the face comparison operation CompareFace
description_zh: 本文介绍人脸比对CompareFace的语法及示例
name: CompareFace

parameters.help_en: The quality score threshold. Performs quality analysis on face images. If the quality score of a face is less than this threshold, a MessageTips field is added to the response
parameters.help_zh: 质量分阈值，对人脸图片进行质量分析判断，若某张人脸质量分小于该阈值，则会在返回结果上增加MessageTips说明
parameters.name: quality_score_threshold

parameters.help_en:
The URL of image A. We recommend that you use an OSS link in the Shanghai region. For files stored locally or OSS links in regions other than Shanghai, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.

Specify either ImageURLA or ImageDataA. If both URL and Base64 encoding are specified, the URL takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
图像A的URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。

ImageURLA与ImageDataA二选一，当URL方式与Base64编码方式共存时，URL方式优先
parameters.name: image_url_a

parameters.help_en:
The URL of image B. We recommend that you use an OSS link in the Shanghai region. For files stored locally or OSS links in regions other than Shanghai, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.
Specify either ImageURLB or ImageDataB. If both URL and Base64 encoding are specified, the URL takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
图像B的URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。
ImageURLB与ImageDataB二选一，当URL方式与Base64编码方式共存时，URL方式优先
parameters.name: image_url_b

parameters.help_en:
The Base64-encoded string of image A. If both URL and Base64 encoding are specified, the URL takes precedence. For information about Base64 encoding, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468191.html.
Specify either ImageURLA or ImageDataA. If both URL and Base64 encoding are specified, the URL takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
图像A的Base64编码字符串。当与URL方式共存时，URL方式优先。文件的Base64编码处理操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468191.html。
ImageURLA与ImageDataA二选一，当URL方式与Base64编码方式共存时，URL方式优先
parameters.name: image_data_a

parameters.help_en:
The Base64-encoded string of image B. If both URL and Base64 encoding are specified, the URL takes precedence. For information about Base64 encoding, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468191.html.
Specify either ImageURLB or ImageDataB. If both URL and Base64 encoding are specified, the URL takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
图像B的Base64编码字符串。当与URL方式共存时，URL方式优先。文件的Base64编码处理操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468191.html。
ImageURLB与ImageDataB二选一，当URL方式与Base64编码方式共存时，URL方式优先
